turns.assessment: The failure is localized to the S15 endpoint of lightpath och224. Its critical EQPT_CARD_FAIL alarm coincides with the service and optical failures; the same unit loses valid receive monitoring, while the far-end S08 interface reports OCH_LOS. The subsequent loss of channel 35 at every downstream OCM from S15 to S08, with unchanged span/amplifier telemetry, confirms loss of this channel at its source rather than a line-system fault.

proposals.rationale: The S15 och224 line interface directly raised EQPT_CARD_FAIL at onset. A card failure explains local monitoring becoming invalid, loss of its transmitted channel at the S08 far end, and the downstream OCM channel losses along S15-S01-S13-S23-S08.

A failed S15 transmitter could cause the downstream channel and far-end LOS, but it does not explain the explicit card-failure alarm and loss of valid receive monitoring at the S15 unit as well as a card failure does.
